propositions: Existing stores lack .bridge_state/projects.json and bridge_project ticket fields, causing every ticket to resolve as absent-project with no recorded legacy default after upgrade.
Two idempotent ensure units must seed the projects mapping (recording legacy_default once) and conditionally stamp multi-project-bridge capability, without writing any ticket events.
The seed unit writes .bridge_state/projects.json only if absent, with legacy_default and a single projects entry from Backend.project, and only when the store has existing tickets.
The stamp unit converges multi-project-bridge into required_capabilities only when the mapping holds more than one project but the capability is missing, and never fires from the same sweep's seed.

The migration is implemented as ensure-registry entries in src/rebar/_store/project_ensures.py (new module) wired into src/rebar/_store/ensures.py, preserving the zero-commit-when-converged property via tree-checks.
The implementation must pass idempotence, zero-ticket-event, and compat-gate-safety tests, with multi-project stamped stores passing check_store_compat on the shipping binary.
